about.title: ABOUT ME
about.bio:
I'm a full stack developer in Manaus, Amazonas, driven by problems that don't have ready-made solutions. I work from Python/Django back ends to React interfaces, across data, infrastructure, and applied AI.

I've built computer vision for workplace safety, a management SaaS, and an AI-powered tour guide. I value readable code, lean delivery, and products that work in the real world.
about.cameraAlt: Digital camera showing project 01 Manaus Tour AI
projects.title: SELECTED WORK
projects.manausTour: Virtual RAG agent built with FastAPI and Gemini, grounded in a curated knowledge base about tourism, history, and food in Manaus. Contextual answers help reduce hallucinations.
projects.guardiao: A 2026 capstone using YOLOv8 computer vision and edge computing to detect PPE in real time. It generates automatic alerts, PDF reports, and a camera-based compliance dashboard.
projects.toVerde: Full-stack platform for reporting and monitoring environmental crimes, connecting citizens and authorities to help fight deforestation, wildfires, and pollution.
projects.portal: Full-stack Django REST and React + TypeScript application for registering and tracking internal requests, with JWT authentication, categories, an analytics dashboard, filters, and CSV export.
